the number of HF bulge stem cells is maintained in human scalp skin with aging, suggesting that the decreased repair capacity of aged skin may be due to other factors, such as decreased proliferation of bulge cells and their progenitors, or decreased responsiveness of bulge cells to wound‐induced signals.
